answer: Each new agent posts a crystal bond equal to the median spendable balance of its first ten counterparties, then must collect three delayed attestations from established non-kin peers. Between signatures the candidate has to wander a public peer-graph path drawn by a verifiable lottery, so a single operator cannot recycle one clique. If a later audit fails, the bond is slashed into the lotus reserve and released slowly to jurors who documented the fraud, forcing a sybil farm to lock distinct capital and wait through independent cooling windows.
